purpose: What one deterministic subject produced under nemo-relay 0.8.2, and what each deliberate interruption removed from the ATOF stream.

subject.description: One agent scope containing one mark, one tool call that succeeds, and one LLM call pointed at a closed loopback port.
subject.llm_error: RuntimeError: internal error: RuntimeError: provider endpoint refused: ConnectionRefusedError

complete.route: observability plugin, config version 3, one ATOF file sink plus ATIF file export
complete.size_measurement_note: atof_bytes is the whole file on disk. largest_single_event_bytes is the largest single JSON line in that file measured in bytes and excluding its trailing newline.

late_registration.detection_rule: the stream carries a scope end whose matching start is absent

missing_root_close.detection_rule: the root scope start has no matching end with the same uuid

no_flush.description: The file sink was read before any flush or shutdown was requested.
no_flush.conclusion: For a seven-event run the file sink had already written every event before the ordered flush ran. This is one observation at one size, not a durability or losslessness guarantee, and Techtree must not treat a written file as proof of complete delivery.

flush_inside_event_loop.description: The ordered teardown was attempted from inside the subject's own asyncio event loop.
flush_inside_event_loop.subscribers_flush: RuntimeError: subscribers.flush() cannot block a running asyncio event loop; use 'await subscribers.flush_async()'
flush_inside_event_loop.consequence: Techtree's teardown must run outside the subject's event loop, or await the async flush. The synchronous flush refuses; the exporter flush does not, so a caller that only calls the exporter flush gets no warning that queued subscriber delivery was never awaited.

hard_death.description: The process called os._exit(9) immediately after the subject finished, with no flush, no shutdown and no teardown.
hard_death.conclusion: The raw file survived, but nothing in it says the run was abandoned. A truncated stream and a complete stream are indistinguishable from the bytes alone, which is why coverage is calculated against declared expectations and why a run with no teardown record is never complete_for_profile.

unwritable_sink.description: An ATOF file sink whose output directory path traverses a regular file.
unwritable_sink.message_shape: failed to open ATOF output file <path>: refusing unsafe observability directory component <name>: Not a directory (os error 20)
unwritable_sink.message_note: The observed message embedded the absolute output path; the path is elided here and is not retained.
unwritable_sink.consequence: A misconfigured sink fails before the subject starts, not silently at flush time.
